releases.name: opencode-llm-vibe 0.1.1
releases.body:
Polished npm-facing README and metadata.

- npm badges, install via `opencode plugin add opencode-llm-vibe`, and a screenshot.
- Preset table, overhead notes, troubleshooting, and development sections.
- Updated package description and pinned-version install example.

Install:

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-llm-vibe
```

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-llm-vibe

releases.name: opencode-llm-vibe 0.1.0
releases.body:
First public release.

- Model-declared mood via the direct `vibe` tool.
- Animated pseudo-graphic blob in the sidebar with palette and shape morphs.
- Context-aware blob size and activity-driven animation tempo.
- `/vibe` toggle; live-only state with no server storage.
- npm: `opencode plugin add opencode-llm-vibe`
